sloka: अथ वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना ।छद्मना घातितौ शूरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ५.२४.४५।।।।
transliteration: atha vā rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena durātmanā ।chadmanā ghātitau śūrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 5.24.45।।।।

translations.english: 'We shall share them. I do not like disputes in this regard. Go swiftly and get drinks and food to lick. Let the accompanying dishes of all variety and quality be brought.'
